name: Fate's Hand — Soulforging (EN)

attribution.text: Original Fate's Hand content: all rights reserved. This layer adds one tool and one spell of its own, and modifies NO material from the System Reference Document 5.2.1: it rewrites no SRD text and disables no SRD record. It patches two SRD spells with an FH-ONLY field, `data[fh_effect]`, which does not exist in the SRD — the SRD spell stands exactly as printed and the Fate's Hand effect is added beside it.

description: Soulforge Crafting, gathered into ONE layer so that it can be switched off in one gesture. Before lot 179 the chapter was scattered across `fh-skills-en` (the tool) and `fh-spells-en` (Transfer Essence, and the Soulforge roles given to Identify and Gentle Repose): no one could turn Soulforging off without also turning off the twelve species’ skill-point pool, or the five other Fate’s Hand spells. ⚠️ ONE MECHANICAL PIECE COULD NOT FOLLOW: the Araag trait `Soulforged Affinity` stays in `fh-species-en`, because a patch cannot create an element in an array (`src/layers/paths.mjs`, rule 3) — no layer above can put a trait back into a record a lower layer added. Turning this layer off therefore leaves that trait standing, and an Araag would still be told he can Body Forge a Soulgem into his own flesh: the switch is not complete until that is decided. FIVE PROSE MENTIONS stay where they are as well — three in `fh-lore-en` (elf, araag, wizard), one in `fh-fiche-en` (the Araag trait line), one that is only a build note — because a sentence is not cut in two across layers.

data.components: V, S, M (a gemstone, which the spell fills)
data.description:
You draw the Essence of a freshly slain creature into a gemstone you hold. The gem's value must meet the essence's PP — from 50 GP (1 PP) to 50,000 GP (11 PP); see the gem table in Soulforge Crafting. The transfer automatically succeeds.

In the Demon Forest this spell is needless — those beasts already carry their essence in the gems crusting their bodies; simply take the gem.
data.name: Transfer Essence
data.range: Touch — a creature slain within the hour (Gentle Repose: 10 hours)

changes.data[fh_effect]: Cast on a harvested catalyst part, Identify reveals the exact power that part will grant once forged. The Knowledge check only tells you that a part is a catalyst; only Identify tells you what it does.

srd:spell:en:identify.note: Fate's Hand gives Identify a role in Soulforge Crafting. The spell works as printed.

changes.data[fh_effect]: Three uses in Soulforge Crafting, which stay decay in body and soul. Salvage: on a slain creature, grants one extra ingredient-retrieval attempt beyond the 1d4-minute harvest window. Essence storage: extends the window to store an Essence into a gem from 1 hour to 10 hours. Ingredient viability: recast every 10 days, keeps well-harvested Structure and Catalyst parts viable indefinitely, instead of the normal one month.

srd:spell:en:gentle-repose.note: Fate's Hand gives Gentle Repose three roles in Soulforge Crafting. The spell works as printed.
